title: Civic Packet Watch
subtitle: A small public instrument for agendas, packets, revisions, and civic deadlines.
affiliation: Independent PointCast public-information reader. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the City of El Segundo.
disclaimer: Official city pages and documents remain authoritative. Verify dates, revisions, submission instructions, and legal requirements at the linked source before acting.

collection.summary: Official city listing pages, event pages, and linked PDFs were read and normalized into a point-in-time baseline. A bounded Firecrawl refresh script is included but automated publication is not enabled.
collection.accessBoundary: The collector does not authenticate, evade access controls, ignore robots.txt, or collect private pages. If a source rejects an automated request, the refresh records the failure for human review.
collection.promotionRule: A crawl result becomes public only after a human checks the official source URL, dates, status, and change label.

signals.title: RFQ 26-05 - Teen Center Public Art
signals.body: The City is seeking artists or artist teams for site-specific public art at the renovated Teen Center. The official packet lists a $97,750 total project budget and a $750 honorarium for each of three shortlisted artists or teams.
signals.action: Questions are due August 19 at 5:00 PM PDT. The packet states qualifications are due September 16 at 11:00 AM PDT.

details.deadlineConflictNote: The listing header displays 5:00 PM, while the RFQ body and official packet state 11:00 AM PDT. PointCast does not resolve the discrepancy; verify with the City and follow the official packet.

compact: Read only official public sources and retain the source URL.
Identify the collector and keep the scope narrow.
Respect robots.txt, access controls, server responses, and a human pace.
Record availability and conflict; do not invent a missing packet or resolve a deadline silently.
Call the first snapshot a baseline, not news.
Keep people out of the index unless a public role is necessary to understand the record.
Publish a machine-readable twin and a visible last-checked time.
Let the source remain authoritative and make correction or removal requests easy.
